source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2020 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 2020 special Arizona U.S. Senate election. All 19 official named candidates, including write-ins, and all 15 county records reconcile to the printed statewide canvass totals. The official PDF host returned 403; retained indexed official table text and a reviewed CSV provide the canvass reference. Checksums identify retained text/CSV, not an unavailable original PDF binary. Special election for the term expiring January 2023. County results and turnout come from the retained official XML ZIP acquired from a pinned public mirror; every candidate/county cell and statewide total matches the independently extracted final canvass. XML Mathew Haupt is displayed as Matthew Haupt following the final canvass.
